blocks.zh: 一般考量
blocks.en: General Considerations

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives / 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Understand non-GMP regulatory considerations (environmental, health & safety) that affect sterile facility design / 理解影響無菌設施設計的非GMP法規考量（環境、健康與安全）
blocks.en: Understand non-GMP regulatory considerations (environmental, health & safety) that affect sterile facility design

blocks.zh: Identify key waste water management strategies and the GMP-vs-GEP conflict in recycling / 辨識廢水管理策略，以及回收再利用與GMP之間的潛在衝突
blocks.en: Identify key waste water management strategies and the GMP-vs-GEP conflict in recycling

blocks.zh: Recognize noise control challenges unique to sterile facilities with large HVAC systems / 認識無菌設施大型HVAC系統的噪音控制挑戰
blocks.en: Recognize noise control challenges unique to sterile facilities with large HVAC systems

blocks.zh: Apply health & safety design principles including containment, fire prevention, and means of escape / 運用含密閉、防火與逃生路線之健康安全設計原則
blocks.en: Apply health & safety design principles including containment, fire prevention, and means of escape

blocks.zh: Evaluate site selection factors critical for sterile product manufacturing / 評估無菌產品製造之廠址選擇關鍵因素
blocks.en: Evaluate site selection factors critical for sterile product manufacturing

blocks.zh: Understand energy conservation, security, and auditing/reporting requirements / 理解能源節約、安全防護與稽核報告要求
blocks.en: Understand energy conservation, security, and auditing/reporting requirements

blocks.zh: 10.1 Introduction 10.1 簡介
blocks.en: 10.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 教學解析
blocks.en: Teaching Notes

blocks.zh: 核心概念：非GMP法規也會影響GMP合規
blocks.en: Core Concept: Non-GMP Regulations Also Affect GMP Compliance

blocks.zh: 本章的關鍵訊息：一個無菌設施可能完全符合GMP，但如果忽略了環境法規、職業安全法規或消防法規，仍然無法合法運營。設施設計必須同時滿足GMP和GEP兩個層面的要求。
blocks.en: The key message of this chapter: a sterile facility can be fully GMP-compliant and still be unable to operate legally if environmental, occupational safety or fire regulations are neglected. Facility design must satisfy both GMP and GEP requirements.

blocks.zh: 更複雜的是，GEP要求有時會與GMP產生衝突（例如：廢水回收 vs. 交叉污染風險），需要在設計階段預先協調。
blocks.en: To complicate matters, GEP requirements sometimes conflict with GMP (for example, waste water recycling vs. cross-contamination risk), and these conflicts need to be reconciled up front at the design stage.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：餐廳不只要衛生合格
blocks.en: Analogy: A Restaurant Needs More Than a Hygiene Certificate

blocks.zh: 一家餐廳即使食安評鑑滿分（= GMP合規），如果消防設備不合格、噪音擾鄰被投訴、廚餘油水直排下水道，一樣會被停業。藥廠也是如此——GMP只是合規拼圖的一塊，環安衛是另一塊不可或缺的部分。
blocks.en: Even a restaurant with a perfect food safety score (= GMP compliance) will be shut down if its fire equipment fails inspection, its noise draws neighbor complaints, or it discharges kitchen grease straight into the drain. The same applies to a pharmaceutical plant: GMP is only one piece of the compliance puzzle, and EHS is another piece that cannot be left out.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：屬地原則（Local Legislation Prevails）
blocks.en: Key Point: Local Legislation Prevails

blocks.zh: ISPE明確指出：設施必須遵守所在國的法規，即使產品出口到其他國家。這在CDMO特別重要——客戶可能來自不同國家，但廠房必須先符合當地法規。有時當地法規比目標出口國更嚴格。
blocks.en: ISPE states clearly that a facility must comply with the laws of the country where it is located, even if the product is exported to other countries. This matters especially for a CDMO: clients may come from different countries, but the facility must first meet local regulations, which are sometimes stricter than those of the target export market.

blocks.zh: 10.2 Environmental – General 10.2 環境 – 一般
blocks.en: 10.2 Environmental – General

blocks.zh: 核心概念：GMP vs. GEP 潛在衝突
blocks.en: Core Concept: Potential GMP vs. GEP Conflicts

blocks.zh: 無菌製程天生就是「高環境負擔」的：
blocks.en: Aseptic processing is inherently a "high environmental burden" activity:

blocks.zh: 大量用水：WFI製備、清洗、滅菌都需要純水
blocks.en: Heavy water use: WFI generation, cleaning and sterilization all require purified water

blocks.zh: 高能耗：HVAC系統24/7運轉維持潔淨度
blocks.en: High energy consumption: HVAC systems run 24/7 to maintain cleanliness

blocks.zh: 一次性耗材：Single-Use Systems的塑膠廢棄物
blocks.en: Single-use consumables: plastic waste from single-use systems

blocks.zh: 環保法規要求減量回收，但GMP要求防止交叉污染。設計工程師必須在兩者之間找到平衡。
blocks.en: Environmental regulations call for reduction and recycling, while GMP requires prevention of cross-contamination. Design engineers must strike a balance between the two.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：排氣管理的三層邏輯
blocks.en: Key Point: The Three-Layer Logic of Exhaust Management

blocks.zh: 第一優先：源頭密閉（At-source containment）——在產生點就控制住
blocks.en: First priority: at-source containment, controlling the release at the point of generation

blocks.zh: 第二層：高效排氣過濾（Exhaust filtration）——捕捉逃逸的顆粒
blocks.en: Second layer: exhaust filtration, capturing any particles that escape

blocks.zh: 第三層：HEPA過濾後排放——排入大氣前的最終防線
blocks.en: Third layer: discharge after HEPA filtration, the final barrier before release to atmosphere

blocks.zh: 這個邏輯與製程污染控制策略（CCS）完全一致：源頭控制 > 過程控制 > 末端控制。
blocks.en: This logic is fully consistent with the contamination control strategy (CCS): source control > process control > end-of-line control.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：VOC與薰蒸劑的挑戰
blocks.en: Analogy: The VOC and Fumigant Challenge

blocks.zh: 無菌設施常用VHP（汽化過氧化氫）進行房間薰蒸消毒。薰蒸後，如何安全地去除殘留薰蒸劑是一個工程與環保的雙重挑戰——既要確保房間殘留量低到可以安全進入（職安要求），又要確保排放不超標（環保要求）。
blocks.en: Sterile facilities commonly use VHP (vaporized hydrogen peroxide) to fumigate rooms. Safely removing residual fumigant afterwards is both an engineering and an environmental challenge: residual levels must be low enough for safe re-entry (occupational safety requirement), and emissions must stay within limits (environmental requirement).

blocks.zh: 實務應用：臭氧層破壞物質（ODS）淘汰
blocks.en: Practical Application: Phase-Out of Ozone-Depleting Substances (ODS)

blocks.zh: 凍乾機和HVAC冷媒是無菌設施中最常見的ODS來源。現代設施應使用HFC或HFO替代冷媒。台灣依《蒙特婁議定書》已全面管制CFC，新設施必須確認所有設備冷媒符合最新環保法規。
blocks.en: Freeze dryers and HVAC refrigerants are the most common sources of ODS in sterile facilities. Modern facilities should use HFC or HFO alternative refrigerants. Taiwan has fully controlled CFCs under the Montreal Protocol, and new facilities must confirm that the refrigerants in all equipment comply with the latest environmental regulations.

blocks.zh: 10.3 Environmental – Waste Water 10.3 環境 – 廢水
blocks.en: 10.3 Environmental – Waste Water

blocks.zh: 核心概念：水質梯級利用（Water Quality Cascade）
blocks.en: Core Concept: Water Quality Cascade

blocks.zh: 這是無菌設施節水的核心策略——將較高品質的排放水降級再利用：
blocks.en: This is the core water-saving strategy in sterile facilities: reuse higher-quality discharge water at a lower quality tier.

blocks.zh: WFI排放水 → 鍋爐給水
blocks.en: WFI discharge water → boiler feed water

blocks.zh: 最終沖洗水 → 第一道清洗水
blocks.en: Final rinse water → first wash water

blocks.zh: RO濃排水 → 灌溉用水或冷卻塔補水
blocks.en: RO reject water → irrigation water or cooling tower make-up

blocks.zh: 但每一步降級再利用都必須評估GMP風險——特別是交叉污染的可能性。
blocks.en: However, every step of downgraded reuse must be assessed for GMP risk, particularly the possibility of cross-contamination.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：生物活性廢棄物需按GMP系統管理
blocks.en: Key Point: Biologically Active Waste Should Be Managed as a GMP System

blocks.zh: 處理含活性生物製劑（如活病毒疫苗、細胞培養液）的廢水系統，ISPE建議以GMP系統的標準來設計和驗證。這是因為洩漏可能造成公共衛生風險，系統完整性必須與製程系統同等嚴謹。
blocks.en: For waste water systems handling biologically active materials (such as live-virus vaccines or cell culture fluids), ISPE recommends designing and validating them to GMP system standards. A leak could create a public health risk, so system integrity must be as rigorous as that of the process systems.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：廢水分流如同垃圾分類
blocks.en: Analogy: Waste Water Segregation Is Like Sorting Household Garbage

blocks.zh: 家庭垃圾分為一般垃圾、廚餘和回收物；工廠廢水同樣需要「分流」。含有機溶劑的廢水、含活性藥物成分的廢水、一般清洗廢水——各有不同的處理路徑和排放標準。混在一起不僅增加處理成本，更可能觸犯環保法規。
blocks.en: Household waste is separated into general waste, food waste and recyclables, and factory waste water likewise needs to be "segregated". Waste water containing organic solvents, waste water containing active pharmaceutical ingredients and general wash water each have their own treatment route and discharge standard. Mixing them together not only raises treatment costs but may also breach environmental regulations.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：廢水處理設施選址與HVAC進氣口
blocks.en: Key Point: Siting of the Waste Water Treatment Facility and HVAC Air Intakes

blocks.zh: ISPE特別警告：廢水處理設施的位置必須遠離廠房HVAC進氣口。化學或生物處理過程產生的異味、微生物氣膠，若被HVAC系統吸入潔淨區，將直接衝擊產品品質和環境監測結果。
blocks.en: ISPE specifically warns that the waste water treatment facility must be located well away from the plant HVAC air intakes. Odors and microbial aerosols generated by chemical or biological treatment, if drawn by the HVAC system into the cleanroom, will directly affect product quality and environmental monitoring results.

blocks.zh: CDMO實務檢核
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Checklist

blocks.zh: 你的設施是否已建立廢水分流系統？高風險廢水（含API）是否有獨立處理流程？
blocks.en: Has your facility established a waste water segregation system? Do high-risk waste streams (containing API) have an independent treatment route?

blocks.zh: 廢水處理設施與HVAC進氣口的相對位置是否經過風險評估？
blocks.en: Has the relative position of the waste water treatment facility and the HVAC air intakes been risk assessed?

blocks.zh: 溶劑回收再利用是否有交叉污染風險評估文件？
blocks.en: Is there a cross-contamination risk assessment documented for solvent recovery and reuse?

blocks.zh: 10.4 Environmental Noise 10.4 環境噪音
blocks.en: 10.4 Environmental Noise

blocks.zh: 核心概念：無菌設施的噪音矛盾
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Noise Paradox of Sterile Facilities

blocks.zh: 無菌設施天生就是「吵」的——維持ISO 5/7/8潔淨度需要大量換氣，這意味著：
blocks.en: Sterile facilities are inherently "noisy": maintaining ISO 5/7/8 cleanliness requires a large number of air changes, which means:

blocks.zh: 大型AHU風扇持續運轉
blocks.en: Large AHU fans running continuously

blocks.zh: 壓縮機（冷凍、壓縮空氣）24/7運作
blocks.en: Compressors (refrigeration, compressed air) operating 24/7

blocks.zh: 製程設備（特別是玻璃瓶/安瓿處理線）產生撞擊噪音
blocks.en: Process equipment (especially vial/ampoule handling lines) generating impact noise

blocks.zh: 而潔淨室的硬質光滑表面（不鏽鋼、環氧樹脂）幾乎沒有吸音能力，反而會反射放大噪音。
blocks.en: Meanwhile, the hard, smooth surfaces of cleanrooms (stainless steel, epoxy) have almost no sound absorption and instead reflect and amplify noise.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：降噪材料 vs. 潔淨度的衝突
blocks.en: Key Point: Noise-Reducing Materials vs. Cleanliness

blocks.zh: 傳統吸音材料（泡棉、纖維板）會脫屑（shedding）且容易藏菌，不適合用在潔淨區。ISPE建議的解決方案是從源頭控制：
blocks.en: Conventional sound-absorbing materials (foam, fiberboard) shed particles and can harbor microorganisms, so they are unsuitable for cleanrooms. ISPE recommends controlling noise at the source:

blocks.zh: 使用較大尺寸的風扇以較低轉速運行（同樣風量，更低噪音）
blocks.en: Use larger fans running at lower speed (same airflow, less noise)

blocks.zh: 將噪音設備遠離工作區域
blocks.en: Locate noisy equipment away from work areas

blocks.zh: 使用可清洗、不脫屑的特殊吸音材料
blocks.en: Use special sound-absorbing materials that are cleanable and non-shedding

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：潔淨室如同「瓷磚浴室」
blocks.en: Analogy: A Cleanroom Is Like a Tiled Bathroom

blocks.zh: 想像在全貼瓷磚的浴室裡說話——聲音迴盪放大。潔淨室就是這樣。你不能像客廳一樣掛窗簾或鋪地毯來吸音，因為那些東西會脫屑污染環境。所以唯一的辦法是——讓聲源本身變安靜。
blocks.en: Imagine talking in a bathroom tiled from floor to ceiling: sounds echo and are amplified. A cleanroom is the same. You cannot hang curtains or lay carpet to absorb sound as you would in a living room, because they would shed and contaminate the environment. So the only option is to make the noise source itself quieter.

blocks.zh: 思考題
blocks.en: Discussion Question

blocks.zh: 你的無菌充填線附近的噪音水準是否曾經量測？如果操作人員需要長時間在ISO 7/Grade B區域工作，工作環境噪音是否超過85 dBA（通常是需要佩戴護耳設備的門檻）？
blocks.en: Has the noise level near your aseptic filling line ever been measured? If operators work in an ISO 7/Grade B area for long periods, does the working-environment noise exceed 85 dBA (the usual threshold for requiring hearing protection)?

blocks.zh: 10.5 Environmental – Solid and Concentrated Wastes 10.5 環境 – 固體與濃縮廢棄物
blocks.en: 10.5 Environmental – Solid and Concentrated Wastes

blocks.zh: 核心概念：廢棄物的「搖籃到墳墓」責任
blocks.en: Core Concept: "Cradle-to-Grave" Responsibility for Waste

blocks.zh: ISPE強調一個關鍵法律原則：即使廢棄物已交給外部處理商，產生者仍需負最終責任。這意味著：
blocks.en: ISPE stresses a key legal principle: even after waste has been handed to an external contractor, the generator remains ultimately responsible. This means:

blocks.zh: 必須審慎篩選和監督廢棄物處理承包商
blocks.en: Waste disposal contractors must be carefully selected and supervised

blocks.zh: 處理商需具備適當的許可證和認證
blocks.en: Contractors must hold appropriate permits and certifications

blocks.zh: 跨境運輸危險廢棄物有額外的法規要求
blocks.en: Cross-border transport of hazardous waste carries additional regulatory requirements

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Single-Use Systems的廢棄物挑戰
blocks.en: Key Point: The Waste Challenge of Single-Use Systems

blocks.zh: 現代無菌設施越來越多使用一次性系統（SUS），產生大量塑膠廢棄物。這些廢棄物可能接觸過活性藥物成分，需要特殊處理（去活化或焚燒）。ISPE在10.2.1已提到「depolymerization」——這是一種將塑膠分解回單體以回收再利用的新興技術。
blocks.en: Modern sterile facilities increasingly use single-use systems (SUS), which generate large amounts of plastic waste. This waste may have contacted active pharmaceutical ingredients and need special handling (deactivation or incineration). In 10.2.1 ISPE already mentions "depolymerization", an emerging technology that breaks plastics down into monomers for recycling and reuse.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：毒性廢棄物焚化如同「最後手段」
blocks.en: Analogy: Toxic Waste Incineration Is the "Last Resort"

blocks.zh: 就像醫院的感染性廢棄物必須焚化處理而非丟入一般垃圾場，含有高活性藥物成分（如ADC藥物、細胞毒性藥物）的固態廢棄物也必須透過焚燒徹底銷毀。廠內設置焚化爐雖然便利，但面臨更嚴格的環保許可和社區接受度問題。
blocks.en: Just as infectious waste from hospitals must be incinerated rather than sent to an ordinary landfill, solid waste containing highly potent active ingredients (such as ADC drugs or cytotoxic drugs) must also be completely destroyed by incineration. An on-site incinerator is convenient, but it faces stricter environmental permitting and community acceptance issues.

blocks.zh: 10.6 Health and Safety 10.6 健康與安全
blocks.en: 10.6 Health and Safety

blocks.zh: 核心概念：密閉（Containment）vs. 正壓梯度的衝突
blocks.en: Core Concept: Containment vs. Positive Pressure Cascade Conflict

blocks.zh: 這是無菌設施設計中最具挑戰性的矛盾之一：
blocks.en: This is one of the most challenging contradictions in sterile facility design:

blocks.zh: GMP要求：潔淨區維持正壓梯度，防止外部污染進入（保護產品）
blocks.en: GMP requirement: cleanrooms maintain a positive pressure cascade to keep external contamination out (protecting the product)

blocks.zh: 密閉要求：處理高活性/毒性產品時需要負壓，防止有害物質外洩（保護操作員）
blocks.en: Containment requirement: handling highly potent/toxic products calls for negative pressure to prevent hazardous substances from escaping (protecting the operator)

blocks.zh: 解決方案通常是隔離器（Isolator）或RABS——在正壓潔淨室內建立一個獨立的負壓操作空間，同時保護產品和人員。
blocks.en: The solution is usually an isolator or RABS: a separate negative-pressure operating space within the positive-pressure cleanroom, protecting both product and personnel.

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語：職業暴露限值（OEL）
blocks.en: Key Term: Occupational Exposure Limit (OEL)

blocks.zh: OEL（Occupational Exposure Limit）是設計密閉系統的基礎：
blocks.en: OEL (Occupational Exposure Limit) is the basis for designing containment systems:

blocks.zh: OEL > 10 μg/m³：一般通風控制可能足夠
blocks.en: OEL > 10 μg/m³: general ventilation controls may be sufficient

blocks.zh: OEL 1–10 μg/m³：需要局部排氣或密閉操作
blocks.en: OEL 1–10 μg/m³: local exhaust ventilation or enclosed operation required

blocks.zh: OEL < 1 μg/m³：需要全密閉系統（隔離器）
blocks.en: OEL < 1 μg/m³: full containment system (isolator) required

blocks.zh: OEL數值直接決定了設施設計的複雜度和成本。
blocks.en: The OEL value directly determines the complexity and cost of the facility design.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：消防灑水器與潔淨室的衝突
blocks.en: Key Point: Fire Sprinklers vs. Cleanrooms

blocks.zh: 標準灑水器頭突出天花板會破壞潔淨室的平整天花板設計，造成清潔死角和壓差洩漏點。ISPE推薦使用嵌入式隱藏灑水器（Sealed & Concealed Sprinklers），維持天花板平整的同時符合消防法規。
blocks.en: Standard sprinkler heads protruding from the ceiling break the flat ceiling design of a cleanroom, creating hard-to-clean areas and pressure leakage points. ISPE recommends Sealed & Concealed Sprinklers, which keep the ceiling flush while still meeting fire codes.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：緊急逃生 vs. 門互鎖（Interlock）
blocks.en: Key Point: Emergency Escape vs. Door Interlocks

blocks.zh: 潔淨室常設有門互鎖（兩道門不能同時打開，以維持壓差）。但在緊急逃生時，所有互鎖必須可以被覆蓋（Override）。ISPE建議門採用失效安全（Fail Safe）設計——斷電時自動解鎖，確保人員可以立即撤離。
blocks.en: Cleanrooms often have door interlocks (two doors cannot be open at the same time, to maintain pressure differentials). In an emergency escape, however, all interlocks must be capable of being overridden. ISPE recommends fail-safe door design: doors unlock automatically on power loss so that personnel can evacuate immediately.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：LOTO如同關電箱鎖門
blocks.en: Analogy: LOTO Is Like Switching Off and Locking the Breaker Box

blocks.zh: Lock-Out/Tag-Out（LOTO）就像你在修理家裡電器前，先把總開關關掉並鎖住，貼上「維修中勿開」的標示。在藥廠，這套程序確保維修人員不會被突然啟動的機器傷害——所有能量源（電力、壓縮空氣、蒸氣）都必須被隔離和鎖定。
blocks.en: Lock-Out/Tag-Out (LOTO) is like switching off and locking the main switch, then hanging a "Under repair, do not operate" sign, before you repair an appliance at home. In a pharmaceutical plant, this procedure ensures that maintenance personnel are not injured by a machine starting unexpectedly: all energy sources (electricity, compressed air, steam) must be isolated and locked out.

blocks.zh: 你的設施是否有處理高活性藥物（如ADC payload、細胞毒性藥物）？如果有，OEL是多少？密閉等級是否足夠？
blocks.en: Does your facility handle highly potent drugs (such as ADC payloads or cytotoxic drugs)? If so, what is the OEL, and is the containment level adequate?

blocks.zh: 潔淨區的緊急出口門是否設計為fail safe？斷電時互鎖是否自動解除？
blocks.en: Are the emergency exit doors in cleanroom areas designed to be fail safe? Do the interlocks release automatically on power loss?

blocks.zh: 清潔消毒人員每天配製消毒液時，是否有適當的PPE和通風措施？
blocks.en: Do cleaning and disinfection staff have appropriate PPE and ventilation when preparing disinfectant solutions each day?

blocks.zh: 10.7 Site Selection and Location 10.7 廠址選擇與位置
blocks.en: 10.7 Site Selection and Location

blocks.zh: 核心概念：無菌設施選址的五大關鍵因素
blocks.en: Core Concept: Five Key Factors in Sterile Facility Site Selection

blocks.zh: 環境空氣品質——工業區或農業區的粉塵、化學物質影響HVAC預過濾負荷
blocks.en: Ambient air quality: dust and chemicals from industrial or agricultural areas affect the HVAC pre-filtration load

blocks.zh: 水源品質與可靠性——季節性水質變化會影響WFI系統設計
blocks.en: Water source quality and reliability: seasonal variation in water quality affects WFI system design

blocks.zh: 環境敏感性——周邊是否有保護區、水源地、防洪區
blocks.en: Environmental sensitivity: whether there are nearby protected areas, water source zones or flood zones

blocks.zh: 氣候與地理條件——地震帶、高濕度、極端溫差都影響設施設計
blocks.en: Climate and geography: seismic zones, high humidity and extreme temperature swings all affect facility design

blocks.zh: 基礎設施與法規環境——電力穩定性、天然氣供應、當地官員的配合度
blocks.en: Infrastructure and regulatory environment: power stability, natural gas supply and the cooperation of local officials

blocks.zh: 重點提示：水源的隱藏陷阱
blocks.en: Key Point: Hidden Traps in the Water Source

blocks.zh: ISPE特別提到「過度加氯」問題。自來水公司為確保飲用水安全而大量加氯，但高氯量會：
blocks.en: ISPE specifically mentions the problem of "over-chlorination". Water utilities add large amounts of chlorine to keep drinking water safe, but a high chlorine level will:

blocks.zh: 增加水處理系統（RO/EDI）的負擔
blocks.en: Increase the load on the water treatment systems (RO/EDI)

blocks.zh: 縮短RO膜壽命
blocks.en: Shorten RO membrane life

blocks.zh: 需要額外的脫氯處理步驟
blocks.en: Require an additional dechlorination step

blocks.zh: 台灣的自來水餘氯量通常在0.2-1.0 ppm之間，需要在URS中明確規範進水水質。
blocks.en: Residual chlorine in Taiwan tap water is typically 0.2-1.0 ppm, so the incoming water quality should be clearly specified in the URS.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：廠址選擇如同選擇住家
blocks.en: Analogy: Choosing a Site Is Like Choosing a Home

blocks.zh: 就像選房子不能只看房屋本身——要看學區、交通、鄰居、是否在洪水區、空氣品質等。選藥廠廠址也是一樣：空氣品質決定了HVAC過濾成本，水質決定了純水系統複雜度，地理位置決定了建築結構成本。選錯地方，後續的營運成本會遠超預期。
blocks.en: When choosing a house you do not look only at the house itself; you look at the school district, transport, neighbors, whether it lies in a flood zone, air quality and so on. Choosing a pharmaceutical plant site is the same: air quality determines HVAC filtration cost, water quality determines the complexity of the purified water system, and geographic location determines building structure cost. If you choose the wrong place, later operating costs will far exceed expectations.

blocks.zh: CDMO實務經驗：與地方官員的溝通
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Experience: Communicating with Local Officials

blocks.zh: ISPE用了很大篇幅強調與地方建管/消防/環保官員的早期溝通。這在實務中極其重要——無菌設施的設計（例如潔淨室壓差門互鎖、特殊通風系統、危險物品儲存）對不熟悉製藥業的地方官員來說可能難以理解。
blocks.en: ISPE devotes considerable space to early communication with local building, fire and environmental officials. This is extremely important in practice: the design of a sterile facility (for example, cleanroom pressure differential door interlocks, special ventilation systems, hazardous material storage) can be hard to understand for local officials unfamiliar with the pharmaceutical industry.

blocks.zh: 建議：在概念設計階段就邀請地方官員參訪類似設施，建立互信，避免在審批階段產生不必要的延誤。
blocks.en: Recommendation: invite local officials to visit similar facilities at the conceptual design stage to build mutual trust and avoid unnecessary delays at the approval stage.

blocks.zh: 10.8 Energy Sources 10.8 能源來源
blocks.en: 10.8 Energy Sources

blocks.zh: 核心概念：電力可靠性是無菌設施的生命線
blocks.en: Core Concept: Power Reliability Is the Lifeline of a Sterile Facility

blocks.zh: 無菌設施斷電的後果極其嚴重：
blocks.en: The consequences of a power outage in a sterile facility are extremely serious:

blocks.zh: HVAC停止 → 潔淨室壓差消失 → 環境失控 → 整批產品可能報廢
blocks.en: HVAC stops → cleanroom pressure differentials are lost → environment out of control → the whole batch may be scrapped

blocks.zh: 冷鏈中斷 → 溫度敏感性產品（生物製劑）可能降解
blocks.en: Cold chain interrupted → temperature-sensitive products (biologics) may degrade

blocks.zh: 自動化系統停擺 → 製程參數失去監控
blocks.en: Automation systems down → process parameters are no longer monitored

blocks.zh: 凍乾機斷電 → 正在凍乾的產品可能全部報廢
blocks.en: Freeze dryer loses power → product being lyophilized may be entirely lost

blocks.zh: 因此電力備援系統（UPS + 柴油發電機）是基本配置，而非可選項目。
blocks.en: Power backup systems (UPS + diesel generators) are therefore a basic provision, not an option.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：能源效率的永續趨勢
blocks.en: Key Point: The Sustainability Trend in Energy Efficiency

blocks.zh: ISPE提到的熱回收和汽電共生（Cogeneration）在2018年出版時還是「未來考量」，但到了今天已成為許多新建藥廠的標準配置。無菌設施的HVAC系統是最大能耗來源（通常佔總能耗60-70%），熱回收系統可顯著降低營運成本。
blocks.en: Heat recovery and cogeneration, mentioned by ISPE, were still "future considerations" when the guide was published in 2018, but today they are standard in many new pharmaceutical plants. The HVAC system of a sterile facility is the largest energy consumer (typically 60-70% of total energy use), and heat recovery systems can significantly reduce operating costs.

blocks.zh: ESG報告要求也推動了藥廠投資太陽能板、LED照明、高效馬達等節能設備。
blocks.en: ESG reporting requirements have also driven pharmaceutical companies to invest in energy-saving equipment such as solar panels, LED lighting and high-efficiency motors.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：電壓/頻率如同語言差異
blocks.en: Analogy: Voltage/Frequency Is Like a Language Difference

blocks.zh: ISPE警告「電壓和頻率的誤解」——全球不同國家使用不同的電力規格（例如台灣110V/60Hz，歐洲230V/50Hz）。這就像購買進口設備時的「語言障礙」——設備的電氣規格必須與當地供電相容，否則會造成設備損壞或性能異常。
blocks.en: ISPE warns of "misunderstanding of voltage and frequency": different countries use different power specifications (for example, 110V/60Hz in Taiwan and 230V/50Hz in Europe). It is like a "language barrier" when buying imported equipment: the electrical specification of the equipment must be compatible with the local supply, otherwise equipment damage or abnormal performance will result.

blocks.zh: 你的設施備用發電機能支持多長時間的全負載運作？是否足以完成關鍵製程批次？
blocks.en: How long can your facility standby generator support full-load operation? Is that enough to complete a critical process batch?

blocks.zh: UPS系統覆蓋了哪些關鍵設備？是否包含環境監測系統和BMS？
blocks.en: Which critical equipment does the UPS system cover? Does it include the environmental monitoring system and the BMS?

blocks.zh: 10.9 Auditing, Monitoring, and Reporting 10.9 稽核、監控與報告
blocks.en: 10.9 Auditing, Monitoring, and Reporting

blocks.zh: 核心概念：環評時程對專案的影響
blocks.en: Core Concept: Impact of EIA Timelines on the Project

blocks.zh: ISPE特別提醒：環境影響評估（EIA）需要時間。許多藥廠新建或擴建專案的時程延誤，不是因為工程問題，而是因為環評許可的審批時間被低估。在台灣，環評審查可能需要6-18個月，必須在專案規劃初期就納入時程。
blocks.en: ISPE specifically reminds us that the Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) takes time. Many new-build or expansion projects slip not because of engineering problems but because the approval time for EIA permits was underestimated. In Taiwan, EIA review can take 6-18 months and must be built into the schedule at the very start of project planning.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：GEP文件 vs. GMP文件
blocks.en: Key Point: GEP Documentation vs. GMP Documentation

blocks.zh: 設施的文件系統不僅要滿足GMP（例如確效文件、品質記錄），還需要滿足GEP要求（例如壓力容器檢驗報告、環保排放記錄、消防系統維護記錄）。ISPE建議在URS階段就將非GMP法規要求納入，確保試車文件同時反映GMP和GEP合規。
blocks.en: The facility documentation system must satisfy not only GMP (for example, validation documents, quality records) but also GEP requirements (for example, pressure vessel inspection reports, environmental emission records, fire system maintenance records). ISPE recommends building non-GMP regulatory requirements into the URS stage so that commissioning documentation reflects both GMP and GEP compliance.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：環境管理系統（EMS）
blocks.en: Practical Application: Environmental Management System (EMS)

blocks.zh: 大多數藥廠會採用ISO 14001環境管理系統。對CDMO而言，具備ISO 14001認證不僅是法規要求，更是客戶稽核時展現環境責任的重要證據。EMS應在設施設計階段就開始規劃，而非建廠完成後才補做。
blocks.en: Most pharmaceutical companies adopt an ISO 14001 environmental management system. For a CDMO, ISO 14001 certification is not only a regulatory expectation but also important evidence of environmental responsibility during client audits. The EMS should be planned from the facility design stage, not added after construction is complete.

blocks.zh: 新建或擴建專案的時程是否已包含環評審查所需時間？
blocks.en: Does the schedule for new-build or expansion projects include the time needed for EIA review?

blocks.zh: 設施的試車文件是否同時記錄了GMP和非GMP（消防、環保、職安）合規項目？
blocks.en: Do the facility commissioning documents record both GMP and non-GMP (fire, environmental, occupational safety) compliance items?

blocks.zh: 是否建立了排放登記簿（Emissions Register）以持續監測和記錄？
blocks.en: Has an Emissions Register been established for continuous monitoring and recording?

blocks.zh: 10.10 Security 10.10 安全
blocks.en: 10.10 Security

blocks.zh: 核心概念：實體安全（Physical Security）vs. 邏輯安全（Logical Security）
blocks.en: Core Concept: Physical Security vs. Logical Security

blocks.zh: 藥廠安全防護有兩個層面：
blocks.en: Security in a pharmaceutical plant has two dimensions:

blocks.zh: 實體安全：門禁系統、監視器、管制藥品保險櫃、文件防火櫃、標籤/印刷包材鎖定儲存
blocks.en: Physical security: access control systems, CCTV, controlled drug safes, fireproof document cabinets, locked storage for labels/printed packaging materials

blocks.zh: 邏輯安全：網路防火牆、使用者帳號密碼、製程配方下載權限控制、資料備份
blocks.en: Logical security: network firewalls, user accounts and passwords, access control over downloading process recipes, data backup

blocks.zh: 兩者缺一不可。ISPE在2018年就已強調邏輯安全的重要性，隨著藥廠數位化和工業4.0的推進，這個議題只會越來越關鍵。
blocks.en: Both are indispensable. ISPE already stressed the importance of logical security in 2018, and with the digitalization of pharmaceutical plants and the advance of Industry 4.0, this topic will only become more critical.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：標籤安全——防止標示錯誤的最後防線
blocks.en: Key Point: Label Security, the Last Line of Defense Against Mislabeling

blocks.zh: 標示錯誤（Labeling Error）是藥品召回的主要原因之一。ISPE建議標籤和印刷包材必須：
blocks.en: Labeling errors are one of the main causes of drug recalls. ISPE recommends that labels and printed packaging materials be:

blocks.zh: 儲存在專門的安全區域
blocks.en: Stored in a dedicated secure area

blocks.zh: 防止外部干擾（unauthorized access）
blocks.en: Protected from outside interference (unauthorized access)

blocks.zh: 有適當的環境控制（溫濕度，防止標籤變質）
blocks.en: Kept under appropriate environmental control (temperature and humidity, to prevent label deterioration)

blocks.zh: 建立數量管控（發出與退回的數量核對）
blocks.en: Subject to quantity control (reconciliation of quantities issued and returned)

blocks.zh: 重點提示：21 CFR Part 11 與 Annex 11
blocks.en: Key Point: 21 CFR Part 11 and Annex 11

blocks.zh: 電子記錄和電子簽章的法規要求適用於所有電子化的品質和製程記錄。設施設計時應確保自動化系統（BMS、SCADA、MES）從一開始就符合資料完整性要求——包括審計軌跡（Audit Trail）、權限分級、定期密碼更新等。後期補做比設計階段就納入困難得多。
blocks.en: Regulatory requirements for electronic records and electronic signatures apply to all electronic quality and process records. At the facility design stage, make sure that automation systems (BMS, SCADA, MES) meet data integrity requirements from the outset, including audit trails, tiered access privileges and periodic password renewal. Retrofitting later is much harder than building these in at the design stage.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：藥廠安全如同銀行金庫
blocks.en: Analogy: Pharmaceutical Plant Security Is Like a Bank Vault

blocks.zh: 管制藥品的儲存就像銀行金庫——需要專用保險櫃、門禁記錄、雙人管控。標籤儲存則像印鈔廠的紙張管理——每一張都要追蹤去向。電子資料安全則像網路銀行——防火牆、密碼、權限控制缺一不可。
blocks.en: Storage of controlled drugs is like a bank vault: it needs a dedicated safe, access records and dual control. Label storage is like paper management at a banknote printing works: every single sheet must be tracked. Electronic data security is like online banking: firewalls, passwords and access controls are all indispensable.

blocks.zh: 你的設施的自動化系統（BMS/SCADA/MES）是否已通過21 CFR Part 11合規驗證？
blocks.en: Have your facility automation systems (BMS/SCADA/MES) been validated for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance?

blocks.zh: 管制藥品儲存區是否有雙重門禁和即時庫存記錄？
blocks.en: Does the controlled drug storage area have double-layer access control and real-time inventory records?

blocks.zh: 製程配方（Recipe）的修改權限是否受到嚴格控管？是否有審計軌跡？
blocks.en: Is permission to modify process recipes tightly controlled? Is there an audit trail?
